recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
recipes.description: Creamy beef stroganoff with earthy mushrooms over buttery egg noodles.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of olive oil over medium-high heat in a large pan.
Add 300g beef strips and sauté until browned, about 5-7 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Remove beef and set aside; in the same pan, add 1 medium diced onion and 2 cloves minced garlic.
Add 200g sliced mushrooms, sautéing until softened for about 5 minutes over medium heat.
Stir in 400ml beef broth and simmer for 10 minutes to reduce slightly.
Lower heat and incorporate 150g sour cream, stirring until combined and warmed through.
Meanwhile, cook 200g egg noodles according to package instructions in salted water.
Serve the creamy beef mixture over the drained egg noodles, garnishing with parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Quick and flavorful chicken fried rice with peas and carrots.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 200g diced chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes.
Stir in 1/2 cup peas and 1/2 cup diced carrots; cook for another 3-4 minutes until tender.
Push the chicken and veggies to one side of the skillet; crack in 1 egg and scramble until cooked.
Add 2 cups cooked rice and 3 tbsp soy sauce; stir-fry everything together for 3-5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then toss in 2 sliced green onions just before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna
recipes.description: Layers of noodles, creamy ricotta, and colorful vegetables baked to perfection.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a baking dish with olive oil.
Sauté 200g fresh spinach, 1 sliced zucchini, 1 diced bell pepper, and 200g chopped mushrooms in 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat until softened, about 7-8 minutes.
In a bowl, mix 400g ricotta cheese, 1 egg, 1 tsp dried basil, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Spread 500ml marinara sauce in the bottom of the baking dish; layer 3 sheets of lasagna noodles on top.
Layer half of the sautéed vegetables and half of the ricotta mixture over the noodles, followed by 100g shredded mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layering process: noodles, sauce, remaining vegetables, remaining ricotta, and another 100g mozzarella.
Finish with a layer of noodles, remaining marinara sauce, and top with 100g grated parmesan cheese.
Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes; then uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes until golden.
Remove from oven, let rest for 10 minutes, then slice and serve.

recipes.title: Zucchini Noodles with Avocado Pesto
recipes.description: A light and creamy avocado sauce over fresh zucchini noodles.
instructions: Spiralize 2 medium zucchini into noodles using a spiralizer and set aside.
Blend 1 large ripe avocado, 1 cup basil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 clove garlic, and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth.
Season the avocado pesto with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper, then stir well.
Toss zucchini noodles in the avocado pesto until well coated, then serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful chickpea curry with fresh spinach and spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté 1 large chopped onion until translucent.
Add 1 inch piece grated ginger and 2 cloves minced garlic, sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in 2 tbsp curry powder and cook for another 1 minute, allowing the spices to bloom.
Add 1 can (400g) drained chickpeas and 1 can (400ml) coconut milk, stirring to combine.
Simmer the curry for 15 minutes, allowing it to thicken slightly while stirring occasionally.
Add 200g fresh spinach, stirring until wilted, then season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Quinoa and Black Beans
recipes.description: Colorful bell peppers filled with quinoa, black beans, and spices, then baked to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and prepare a baking dish with olive oil.
Cook 1 cup quinoa in 2 cups water according to package instructions for about 15 minutes.
Chop 1 large onion and sauté in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat until soft and translucent.
Combine cooked quinoa, 1 can (400g) drained black beans, 1 cup corn, sautéed onion, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp chili powder in a bowl.
Slice the tops off 4 large bell peppers and remove seeds, then fill with the quinoa mixture.
Sprinkle 1 cup shredded cheese on top of the stuffed peppers before placing in the oven.
Bake the stuffed peppers for 25 minutes at 180°C until the peppers are tender.

recipes.title: Lentil Dahl with Coconut Rice
recipes.description: Creamy lentil dahl served with fragrant coconut rice.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup of brown lentils under cold water and set aside.
Sauté 1 diced onion, 3 minced garlic cloves, and 1 grated inch ginger over medium heat until fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, and stir for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Pour in 2 cups of vegetable broth and add lentils; simmer for 20 minutes until tender.
In a separate pot, combine 1 cup basmati rice and 1 can coconut milk; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until rice absorbs the liquid.
Season dahl with salt, pepper, and 1/4 cup chopped coriander before serving.
Serve dahl over coconut rice, with a squeeze of lime on top.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
recipes.description: A fragrant and hearty chicken tagine packed with spices and dried fruits.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of olive oil in a tagine or pot over medium heat, then brown 500g chicken thighs on all sides for 10 minutes.
Remove chicken and sauté 1 large chopped onion, 4 minced garlic cloves, and 1 inch grated ginger for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 tsp turmeric, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 1 large sliced carrot, 1 diced bell pepper, 1 can (400g) tomatoes, and cooked chicken back to the pot; stir well.
Pour in 1 can (400g) drained chickpeas and 1/2 cup chopped apricots, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally until chicken is fully cooked.
Serve hot, garnished with 1/4 cup chopped coriander and slivered almonds on top.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp Tacos with Mango Salsa
recipes.description: Zesty shrimp tacos topped with sweet mango salsa and spicy sauce.
instructions: Mix 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper in a bowl; coat 300g shrimp.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook shrimp for 4-5 minutes until pink.
In a bowl, combine 1 diced mango, 1 small finely chopped red onion, 1 minced jalapeño, and juice of 1 lime.
To assemble, fill 6 taco shells with shredded cabbage and cooked shrimp, then top with mango salsa.
Serve the tacos immediately, garnished with chopped coriander if desired.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Stroganoff
recipes.description: Creamy beef stroganoff served over egg noodles for ultimate comfort.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; add 300g beef sirloin and brown for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Add 1 medium chopped onion and 200g sliced mushrooms into the skillet; sauté until soft for 5 minutes over medium heat.
Stir in 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant over medium heat.
Sprinkle in 2 tbsp of flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly over medium heat to form a roux.
Gradually whisk in 500ml beef broth and bring to a simmer, thickening for about 5 minutes over medium heat.
Lower the heat and stir in 150g sour cream until well combined and smooth; season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook 200g egg noodles according to package instructions; drain and set aside.
Serve the beef stroganoff over the cooked egg noodles and garnish with 2 tbsp chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Stuffed Peppers
recipes.description: Colorful bell peppers filled with quinoa, black beans, and spices for a healthy bite.
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C; prepare 4 large bell peppers by cutting the tops off and removing seeds.
Cook 1 cup of quinoa according to package instructions; set aside when fluffy.
Sauté 1 chopped onion in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Combine cooked quinoa, 1 can black beans, 1 cup corn, 1 diced tomato, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, and salt in a bowl; mix well.
Stuff each prepared bell pepper with the quinoa mixture; top with 1/2 cup shredded cheese.
Place stuffed peppers in a baking dish and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: Tender chicken breasts in a bright lemon-caper sauce served with pasta.
instructions: Cook 200g spaghetti according to package instructions and drain; set aside.
Flatten 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts and dredge in 1/2 cup flour; season with salt and pepper.
Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; add chicken and cook for 6 minutes each side until golden brown.
Remove chicken and melt 2 tbsp butter in the same skillet; add 2 tbsp capers and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in 1/2 cup chicken broth and juice of 1 lemon; simmer for 2 minutes to reduce sauce.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook for 2 more minutes; garnish with 2 tbsp parsley before serving.
Serve chicken piccata over spaghetti and drizzle with the lemon-caper sauce.
